async def act(page):
    # Hover over the Reports link to expand the dropdown menu
    await page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('link', name=' Reports').hover()
    # Wait a moment for the menu to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Click on the 'Invoiced' report link under the Reports menu
    await page.get_by_role('menu').get_by_role('link', name='Invoiced').click()
    # Wait for navigation to the report page
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Set the date range for last year (2022)
    await page.get_by_label('From').fill('2022-01-01')
    await page.get_by_label('To').fill('2022-12-31')
    # Click the button to show the report
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Show Report').click()
    # Wait for the report to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Since the task is to generate the report, and instructions say to return API response or print,
    # I'll check if there's an API response or data on the page.
    # For now, I'll assume the report is displayed and return a success message.
    # If there's specific data to extract, I would do so here, but per instructions, I should not process it.
    # I'll output the page content or a confirmation.
    report_data = await page.content()
    print(report_data)
